messages:
maria: Quick sync — LangChain adapter merged yesterday. Need alignment on marketplace listing + HW partner benchmark callouts before any public comms. Who owns what?
ajay: Nice. Can we include a 'Works with Redwood Dedicated' badge on the marketplace tile? HW partner asked for specific GPU perf numbers to call out.
nick: I can produce a short perf snapshot. Which configs do we want public? My suggestion: 8k context, fp16 quantized on A100 and H100, batch=8. I can run today.
elaine: DevEx needs a runnable sample and quickstart showing LangChain + gateway + Redwood Dedicated. Minimal repo + docker snippet. ETA?
sam: Heads up from Sales/Partners — IntegrateSys (SI) and CloudMarket want a coordinated announcement. Their PR window is Nov 7-10 and they'd prefer Nov 9. We need embargo alignment.
maria: We can't commit to dates until marketplace listing is approved and legal signs off on co-marketing. @tony, partner-ops — where are we on marketplace review?
tony: Marketplace listing review is in progress; legal is looking at co-marketing language. ETA 3 business days for review and two days for minor edits. Might slide if they request extra assets.
nick: I'll kick off the regression + connectivity smoke vs IntegrateSys connector. Command I'll run: ```./ci/smoke-si-connector.sh --model=redwood-llama2 --context=8192 --gpu=h100``` Will post logs to the thread.
deploy-bot: Reminder: announcement checklist updated — https://internal/redwood/announcements/checklist (item 7 = legal signoff).
elaine: :thumbsup: I'll scaffold the sample repo and a one-file quickstart showing LangChain pseudocode + gateway config. Plan to push a draft by EOD Wed.
sam: Marketing requests a 90s demo clip highlighting latency + cost delta vs hosted API. Can we capture that from the perf run?
maria: Plan proposal: (1) Tony: finish marketplace + legal (2) Nick: perf artifacts + logs (3) Elaine: sample repo + quickstart (4) Sam: confirm embargo window with IntegrateSys/CloudMarket. If everything green, target Nov 9 for coordinated publish. Everyone ok with that? :rocket:
ajay: Agree, will schedule 30m pre-announce sync for Thurs to validate assets and finalize tile copy.
maria: Thanks. If any blocker pops up, flag here. Otherwise I'll circulate a one-pager for partner execs tomorrow.
